stories.unit: his usual likes · the Bigg Boss reel, 27 Oct · after one day
stories.line: A day old and already his biggest post since the politics reel.
stories.why: Bigg Boss lore to camera, captioned 'gotta stay updated on the bigg boss kaashvi scout lore'. 50.3K likes and 228 comments by day 1.
stories.so: His first Bigg Boss post on file. Day 3 says whether it holds.

stories.unit: posts in a row under his usual comments · 21–25 Oct · still going
stories.line: Seven in a row, and nobody had much to say.
stories.why: Five from Tokyo, the BMW night drive in Mumbai and a street chant with Ruhee. Comments ran at 0.6× his usual across the run.
stories.so: Sightseeing gives his crowd nothing to answer.

stories.unit: things that carry him, all gone quiet
stories.line: The three things that carry him all stopped at once.
stories.why: No politics since 14 Oct, no Shree since 12 Oct, no name in a caption since 8 Oct. Politics did 6.5× his usual likes lately, Shree 3.3×.
stories.so: The named captions pulled 8.8× his usual comments. Since then: ads and a holiday.

stories.unit: likes on his typical post this month · 10.6K in July
stories.why: July was politics most weeks, and his typical post got 10.6K likes. September was Shree and ads; October was ads and Japan.
stories.so: That's a fifth of July's typical post.

stories.unit: his usual likes · the Nykaa ad, 19 Oct
stories.line: His worst post this week was an ad. Again.
stories.why: Anuj reviewing body wash while his parents heckle him off camera: 310 likes, his fewest in 90 days. Back in April, an ad with his friends in it did 7.2×. Only 5 of his last 27 ads beat his usual post.
stories.so: He's getting paid. The feed isn't.

stories.unit: his usual comments · the Pierre Cardin ad, 22 Oct
stories.why: A couples-therapy skit: Rohit and Simran fight over his sports shoes, Anuj plays the therapist, and the sneakers only turn up at 0:39. 140 comments. Likes came in at his usual, which for one of his ads counts as a win.
stories.so: It's the Myntra floor-20 trick again: the bit comes first, the brand is the punchline.

stories.unit: followers this week · his worst of 29 weeks on file
stories.line: He lost followers every single day.
stories.why: Ten losing days in a row by 28 Oct, the longest stretch on file: 1,526 gone.
stories.so: The 10 Oct reel was the last to bring a crowd. Even the 17× diploma reel four days later brought none.

stories.why: One a day Monday to Thursday, then seven from Friday to Sunday, six of those from Japan.
stories.so: The trip changed what he posted. The count held.
